items.summary: Update the Profile tab UI to remove the entire "Additional Information" card/section (the section above leaderboard rankings), and instead render distinct sections for "Leaderboard Rankings" and "Match History" on the profile page.

Implement a Match History list on the Profile tab that shows a single combined chronological list of the caller's last 5 availabilities played, where each list item displays the date and the wins and losses recorded for that date.

Add backend query API(s) to support Profile > Match History by returning the caller’s available day IDs and the caller’s per-day win/loss totals (DailyLog) for those days, with user-only authorization enforced consistently with existing stats/availability endpoints.

Update React Query hooks and consuming pages to use the new backend query API(s) for fetching the caller’s available days (and per-day win/loss data) without requiring admin permissions, and integrate these hooks into the Profile page Match History UI.
